about: The Anchor's radio imaging for TWENTY ONE ESPORTS RADIO (plan "TWENTY ONE Radio", P11; user 2026-10-12: "aufregendere Jingles, die viel länger sind vom ANCHOR, und mehr unterschiedliche Jingles und Stinger und Betten"). One VoiceStudio call per line (caster:jingles), produced over self-made stingers and beds (JingleSynth::produce...), -16 LUFS, uploaded to the server as its imaging (caster:imaging-upload). Voice: VoiceStudio personality us_news_anchor, a designed voice, no person's clone. English only; `spoken` writes ESPORTS as "E. Sports.". Categories are what App\Support\Caster\Imaging asks for: station-long, station-short, sweeper, liner, opener-<format>, news-open, news-close, promo-<format>, promo, power-intro, autopilot-hour (the news-free station ID at :00 while the workstation is off, P18). No invented facts: lines name formats and the station, never a number, a date or a person.
